item.description: In RYGB mice, Scl-Ab improved femoral biomechanical properties and trabecular bone architecture, increasing trabecular bone area and thickness. In contrast, Scl-Ab further increased RYGB-associated cortical porosity, highlighting divergent effects on trabecular and cortical bone.

item.title: Laundered Survival: When Target Trial Emulation Doesn't Emulate-Implications for GLP-1 Receptor Agonists and Cancer Outcomes.
item.description: Target trial emulation (TTE) is increasingly invoked in observational studies to address time-related biases. Recent observational studies reporting large protective associations between glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) and cancer outcomes have cited TTE as a methodological strength.

item.title: Where patients obtain GLP-1 receptor agonists: direct-to-consumer channels, compounded product use, and reason-specific nonadherence in a national survey.
item.description: DTC acquisition was associated with cost-attributed nonadherence (aOR, 4.94; 95% CI, 2.77-8.81); the supply-attributed association was not statistically significant (aOR, 1.15; 95% CI, 0.56-2.38; contrast P < 0.001).
